scope: Owner-requested review of the master audit as a development guide for future chapters, delivered as a written Codex handoff with a read-only measurement tool and a chapter-map seed. It opens MA-DOC-010 and routes the New chapter task and the chapter planning answer to it. It benefits the child indirectly: the next chapter gets the story so far, where it fits, how it plugs into the code and Chapter 2's lessons, so it is less likely to ship a dead end like MA-PLAY-005 or contradict canon the child already knows. No game script, scene, asset, audio, save key or workflow is changed, and no image is made.
